title: Parseval identity for sign-valued functions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional vector space over $\\mathbb F_2$ to signs. Then the sum, over all vectors $\\gamma$ in that space, of the squares of the binary Fourier coefficients of the real-valued function $x\\mapsto f(x)$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional vector space over $\\mathbb F_2$ to signs
